LanguageData.RK_XenoType_Ratkin.label: Ratkin
LanguageData.RK_XenoType_Ratkin.description:
The origins of the Ratkin are unclear, but they are believed to be descendants of humans who developed rat-like traits to survive in harsh environments. They are known for being skilled at growing plants and mining, making them capable pioneers. However, because they are small and have poor eyesight, they have traditionally relied on farming to get their food rather than hunting for it.
Ratkin can be difficult to distinguish by sex, and most have small bodies and cute faces. This cuteness has helped them form social bonds with others, but it can make diplomacy more difficult if they try to be serious.
